headline: Bell MTS says a cyberattack caused its email outage. One outlet so far; Reported.
summary: New incident page. Sources read: Winnipeg Free Press (Nov 22 and Nov 20), CBC (two stories), BleepingComputer, the Globe and Mail (Tier 2). Main question: Reported, because the Nov 22 statement reaches us through one outlet and Bell has not posted it on its own channels. The Bell Canada Nov 17 breach is covered here only as context; it is not on the site as its own page yet. Scale and attacker: Not established. Status monitoring. Privacy check done: no names, bylines, handles or contact details.
author: Editor-in-Chief
